text: The City of Toronto's Shelter, Support and Housing Administration ("SSHA") and Real Estate Services ("RES") Divisions have been working to identify locations for year-round emergency respite and refugee services. Through this review it has been identified that 1155 King Street West ("Carpark 181"), a 353-space surface municipal parking lot currently managed by the Toronto Parking Authority ("TPA") on behalf of the Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division, is a viable option for such a centre. In October 2018, Shelter, Support and Housing Administration and their consultants are targeting to commence the installation of services and a temporary structure at Carpark 181. This report is to advise the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors of this alternate use of the Toronto Parking Authority lot and supersedes a previous version (October 4, 2018), to provide updated parking space…
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Received the report (October 23, 2018) from the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority for information.
